finalists.label: Chromoblastomycosis
finalists.why: It has multiple well-defined brown erythematous scaly plaques with central scarring and pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia, parakeratosis, dense dermal infiltrate of histiocytes, foamy histiocytes, neutrophils, and multinucleate giant cells along with pigmented hyphae.

finalists.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
finalists.why: It has infiltrate of foamy histiocytes and pigmented yeasts without multiaxial septation and fungal skin culture showing black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of fungal skin culture showing black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species, which is a specific evidence for Phaeohyphomycosis.

support_spans: multiple well-defined brown erythematous scaly plaques with central scarring measuring 2 × 1 to 8 × 7 cm on the face, arm, and thighs
infiltrate of foamy histiocytes and pigmented yeasts without multiaxial septation (Fontana-Masson)
pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia, parakeratosis, dense dermal infiltrate of histiocytes, foamy histiocytes, neutrophils, and multinucleate giant cells along with pigmented hyphae
asymptomatic erythematous scaly plaques over the face and proximal extremities
fungal skin culture: black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species
involvement of the upper respiratory tract, causing palatal perforation and stridor, necessitating a tracheostomy a year ago
saddle nose deformity, perforation of the hard palate, and necrotic plaques on the ear with destruction of ear cartilage
cervical lymphadenopathy: multiple, nontender, discrete nodes, ranging from 1.5 to 2 cm without surface changes
contradict_spans: no history of preceding trauma, fever, malaise, joint pain, cough, epistaxis, hemoptysis, or hematuria
